wearable_minimal.py.note: wearable_minimal.py is a MINIMAL REWRITE of the upstream Wearable, not a patched copy: the HR boundary algorithm reads only a small part of the upstream state, and the upstream class imports h5py plus the RawProcessing/CGM stack. The diff below is therefore upstream-vs-rewrite and is recorded for auditability, not as a patch set.

deviations.description: get_frequency_in_secs() never infers the epoch length: upstream falls back to pd.infer_freq (wearable.py:98-115) and raises ValueError on an irregular index. A wrong-but-set frequency silently rescales every window because every window length is expressed in epochs.
the constructor takes the frame directly instead of a HypnosPy HDF5 path or a RawProcessing object, so the vendored package does not pull in h5py / the preprocessing stack.

change_start_hour_for_experiment_day subtracts pd.Timedelta instead of pd.DateOffset(hours=...): both are an absolute whole-hour shift, but on a timezone-aware index pandas 3 re-localises the DateOffset result and raises 'Cannot infer dst time' at the ambiguous hour of a DST fall-back.
